note: Medicine Bow-Routt NF campground on Libby Creek in the Libby Creek Recreation Area, 0.5 mi up Barber Lake Road (FS Road 351) from WY-130, 2 mi NW of Centennial on the Snowy Range Scenic Byway. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov 10250594: 16 sites, trailers under 22 ft (passes), no hookups, hand-pump water Jul-Sep, vault toilet, $20 (2026); 7 reservable sites Jun 19-Sep 12, all first-come May 21-Jun 18 and Sep 13-Oct 3. Stored season closes 09-12 was the end of the reservable season only -> 05-21 to 10-03. 'not waterfront' kept (creek hidden under canopy).
flags: Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: Libby Creek runs under continuous conifer canopy and is not visible at any site on Esri imagery; recreation.gov tags only site 6 'Proximity to Water'. No upgrade.

Rig limit: agency 'trailers under 22 feet' - passes under the AWH 22-ft trailer ruling (2026-10-20); written as sites.max_rig_ft 22 and dropped from the note. Five of the 15 catalogued sites (3, 7, 11, 12, 13) don't permit RVs or trailers.
Season fix: stored closes 09-12 was derived from the reservation calendar; recreation.gov's rate table shows a first-come season to Oct 3 and from May 21 (2026).
Phone: empty -> 307-745-2300 (recreation.gov: 'For facility specific information, please call (307) 745-2300', Laramie Ranger District).
Catalog lists 15 numbered sites (no site 2) plus a scan-and-pay record; agency text says 16 - kept 16.

Pin 41.32130,-106.16599 sits in the main loop (~90 m from the all-site centroid 41.32076,-106.16534) - no move. Sites 12-16 are a second cluster ~360 m SE (41.3195,-106.1628) on the same campground road - not a split. Pine Campground (13675) is the loop between them.
